question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Scared
solution:
The correct answer is: **Afraid**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Scared** means to become frightened__. (डरा हुआ)

** • *Example*-* **** I am really **scared** about speaking in front of the class. *

__
 
• Marked option **Afraid **means filled with fear or apprehension__.

** •* Example-* ***I'm **afraid** I've been putting on weight.*

__
 
• It is clear that **Scared** and **Afraid** are synonymous in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tranquil** means calm, peaceful, and without noise, violence, worry, etc. (शांत)
 
• **Brave **means ready to face and endure danger or pain, showing courage. (साहसी)
 
• **Solemn** means very serious; not happy or smiling. (गंभीर)
